scope: Durable research method, not one iteration's plan. Describes how to find out whether a representation of music is any good, on any hardware. An iteration decides how much of this it can afford; the reduced version the ESP32-S3 wearable pays for is in its dated plan under _architecture/plans/. Narrative version in MODEL.md under 'Research method'.
purpose: Test the provisional reliability claims in concepts.json against real room-microphone audio.

three_sources.offline_mir: what acoustic and musical evidence existed. Reference measurement, not ground truth.
three_sources.device_pipeline: which evidence stays observable through the microphone in real time

recording: Capture each track twice at the same time: a clean digital copy and the room-microphone capture. Run the same offline analysis on both to separate what the microphone path destroys from what the concept makes hard.
track_selection: Chosen to make hypotheses fail. Several minutes each.
tracks_wanted: breakdown not followed by a drop
abrupt cut between very different passages
a track where activity and density separate
a continuous stretch spanning several pieces, with the real gaps and talking between them

annotation.second_listener: a smaller subset, prioritising groove, tension, emotional character and perceived build-up
rules: Annotate the concept, not a detector. Mark what was heard as a build and how strongly, not where loudness rose.
Continuous ratings for states (tension, groove, intensity). Time marks with strength for events.

analysis: For each concept compare several candidate detectors against annotations and against each other, and record disagreements. A valid result is that no reliable detector was found.
open_constraints: whether heavier analysis may run off the device
order_is_fixed: Listen and mark first, compare against signals after. Marking after seeing a trace tests nothing.
valid_outcomes: proxy is not good enough but the concept deserves another proxy
concept does not survive at the timescale this iteration has
no reliable detector found — record what was tried, it is what stops the next iteration repeating it
